A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same POCO research work. All 39 pages, including Appendices A-E and the checklist, support reliable comparison of text, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original forecasting experiments on calcium-imaging datasets, synthetic neural dynamics, and Zapbench, together with ablations and embedding analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 5 and Appendix A, including benchmark comparisons, simulations, fine-tuning, and ablations.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix C retain the same univariate MLP, POYO-derived population encoder, FiLM conditioning, tokenization, embeddings, and forecasting objective.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same five calcium-imaging datasets spanning zebrafish, mice, and C. elegans, plus Zapbench and synthetic RNN data. Cellular/PCA forecasting and the session-transfer scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding main and supplementary experiments. Tables 2-3 retain their baseline sets, and Figure S14 retains linear, UNet, and TSMixer comparisons alongside POCO.

E3.justification: The data partitioning, preprocessing, default 48-step context and 16-step forecast, metrics, training budgets, and fine-tuning procedures match. The separate Zapbench protocol is also unchanged in Appendix D.6.

E4.justification: Both retain the component ablations in Table 5 and the same analyses of context length, training-data scale, simulated individual similarity, embeddings, filtering, and hyperparameter sensitivity, including Figures S6-S20.

E5.justification: Tables 2-5 still report 95% confidence intervals from four seeds, while Tables S9-S10 use three seeds. The experiment-specific run counts and SEM reporting in figure captions also match.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and plotted findings match throughout the main paper and appendices. For example, Table 2 reports MS_POCO scores of 0.525 ± 0.004 on Deisseroth and 0.213 ± 0.030 on Flavell in both versions.

T1.justification: The forecasting and loss definitions, prediction-score formula, model equations, and appendix formulas for simulation and embedding analysis are unchanged. Neither version introduces formal theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and discussion retain the same claims about forecasting accuracy, scalability, rapid session adaptation, and biologically structured unit embeddings.

C2.justification: Interpretations of multi-session benefits, limited multi-species transfer, filtering effects, and simulation results are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning dataset differences, alignment, embedding generalization, and calcium-imaging coverage.

D1.justification: Appendices B-E retain identical processing instructions, implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware descriptions, and runtime estimates. The code link and dataset-access disclosures are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the positioning relative to POYO and POYO+, and all 60 references are unchanged. No cited work or substantive novelty comparison is added or removed.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 17 June 2025 to v2 dated 24 October 2025. Manuscript wording, authors, headings, and section organization otherwise match.

P2.justification: Figures 1-5 and S6-S20 and Tables 1-5 and S6-S10 retain their content, captions, structure, and placement. Embedded images and vector graphics match; negligible glyph-position differences do not change the layout.

improvement.justification: v2 retains the same scientific argument, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and limitations throughout the main paper and appendices. The updated arXiv stamp and negligible typesetting differences provide no meaningful net change in paper quality.
